Acetylsalicylic acid — the archetypal small-molecule analgesic and the product of the
esterification this corpus uses as its worked example.

- also written: aspirin, ASA, 2-acetoxybenzoic acid
- role: API
- melting point: 135 °C (literature)

Made from [[precursor-of:compound-salicylic-acid]] by acetylation; see [[rxn-aspirin-acetylation]].
